note: State beach south of Watsonville on Monterey Bay, with campsites among Monterey pines and cypress between farm fields and a broad dune field above a long sandy beach. Three loops: South Camp stays open all winter; Pines Hollow and Dunes Camp close for the winter (out of season on ReserveCalifornia from December through March, open by early April 2027). The nearest dump station is at New Brighton State Beach in Capitola. No hookups. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page, 2016 campground map and ReserveCalifornia catalog read. $35 and 31 ft confirmed; 85 -> 81 sites; 7-night max; showers/water added, dump cleared (it is at New Brighton SB); South Camp year-round, Pines Hollow/Dunes closed Dec-Mar. Coastal dunes questioned: the park road runs between every loop and the dune field.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade recommended, coastal dunes -> coastal walk): on Esri every loop (Dunes Camp around the stored pin 36.8905,-121.8311; Pines Hollow ~36.8883,-121.8295; South Camp ~36.8849,-121.8274) lies EAST of the paved park road that runs the length of the park; the undeveloped dune-scrub field (~150-200 m) and the beach lie west of it. The stored evidence says 'no road/day-use complex between camp and shore', which imagery contradicts. The curation doc lists 'a road/highway between camp and shore' as disqualifying coastal dunes; for coastal walk only a highway, town, rail line or residential strip counts, and the park's own road may lie between. So coastal walk is clearly earned; coastal dunes depends on whether the park's own road counts. Replacement evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-27: all three loops east of the paved park road; west of it the park's undeveloped dune-scrub field ~150-200 m to the Monterey Bay beach, footpaths across -> coastal walk (the park road between camp and dunes rules out coastal dunes)'. Not an --AWH value.
